saw_lines: Parents buying a used stroller or car seat want proof it was safety checked before they trust a low price.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where parents trust the inspection or scroll past the price.
Your site runs 25% off SlumberPods and free shipping over $100, so put one of those in the first line of the next Google batch.
